in_telugu.name: బఘ్చంద
in_telugu.meaning: ఫలేశ్యోదేశోదేశోదేశోదేశః (Bhag-an-da, One who is Fortune, Wealth, and Blessedness itself)

in_marathi.name: Bhagchand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessed with fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagchand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagchand is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Bhag and Chand. Bhag means 'fortune' or 'prosperity', and Chand means 'moon'. Thus, Bhagchand can be interpreted as 'Blessed with fortune' or 'God of Fortune'.

Bhag means 'fortune' or 'prosperity', and Chand means 'moon'. Thus, Bhagchand can be interpreted as 'Blessed with fortune' or 'God of Fortune'.
